segments.caption: The camera slowly pans across a rugged, sunlit rock formation, revealing a dark, narrow crevice or cave entrance nestled between the jagged stones. The scene remains static, focusing on the contrast between the bright, textured rock surfaces and the deep, shadowy void within the opening.
The camera slowly pans downward into a narrow, dark crevice between rugged, sunlit rock formations, revealing a small, bright white object resting at the bottom of the shadowed opening.
A large tour bus, marked "803 CHARTERED" and "STAGECOACH," slowly emerges from a narrow, rocky tunnel, its headlights illuminating the rugged stone walls as it navigates the tight passage.

A Stagecoach Western charter bus, numbered 803, slowly and steadily drives forward through a narrow, rocky mountain tunnel, its front end gradually emerging from the dark passage into the bright daylight.

A white Stagecoach West bus, numbered 803, is shown stuck nose-first in a narrow, rocky canyon or pass. The vehicle is wedged between towering rock walls, with its front end protruding into a deep crevice. A man in an orange shirt is seen walking near the rear of the bus, likely assessing the situation or attempting to assist. A Stagecoach West tour bus, numbered 803, carefully navigates a narrow, winding road squeezed between towering rock formations, with passengers visible on the side and a red vehicle following behind.
